title: E-commerce Event Mapping Worksheet
description: A neutral mapping template. Populate event names and fields only after checking the current official documentation for the selected platform and account.
validation_notes: Distinguish placed, confirmed, paid, fulfilled, cancelled, and returned orders according to the merchant's definitions.
Do not assume event names, field paths, attribution windows, deduplication windows, or plan availability are identical across platforms.
Minimize personal data and follow the merchant's documented consent, access, and retention practices.
Reconcile test and reported events against the source order system before drawing conclusions.
